title: Me vs. Chatbot: Ask Us Anything
content:
Would you like to have your art question answered in a future YouTube video?View this post on InstagramA post shared by James Gurney (@jamesgurneyart)The idea is to see who answers better: real me, or Jimbot, the AI chatbot, who is trained on all my blog posts, books, and magazine articles. (In the “fake” chatbot version, it’s actually me reading the lines, but everything I say is scripted by my digital double).

Send your question for either or both of us at thisSpeakpipe link.
